capabilities: Download remote attachments when a note is opened
Serve cached local copies at render time for offline reading
Preserve original network links in note content
Deduplicate cached files by content hash
Delete cache files no longer referenced by any note
extras: Newly inserted remote attachments are not cached until the note is reopened; users must exclude the .cache folder from Git and sync tools (Obsidian Sync, Dropbox, OneDrive). Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Remote attachments in notes need a network connection every time, and typical download-and-replace plugins rewrite links and bloat synced vaults.
summary: Caches remote attachments on note open and serves local copies at render time, enabling offline reading without rewriting your links.
